name: Invokely
description: Query official statistics through MCP or REST for developers and AI agents. Retrieve values, series, comparisons and rankings with periods, units and source citations.

skills.name: Find Indicators and Places
skills.description: Find official statistical indicators by topic, then resolve places to normalized entities and confirm their official codes.

skills.name: Retrieve Figures
skills.description: Get a latest or period-specific figure with its unit, period, status, source URL, retrieval date and ready-made citation.

skills.name: Explore Time Series
skills.description: Return a single-source time series for one place, including periods, values, gaps and separately requested projections.

skills.name: Compare Places
skills.description: Compare one indicator across two to ten places for the same period and report whether the values are comparable.

skills.name: Rank Places
skills.description: Rank countries, regions, counties or Spanish municipalities by an indicator using one source and period for the ranking.
